verdict.rationale: Google Drive API v3 documentation covers upload (simple/multipart/resumable), list/search files, permissions/sharing (move via parent changes implied by files resource), file metadata, properties, changes/push notifications, and OAuth scopes — a comprehensive documented REST API distinct from the desktop client. missing for 10: no independent/community hands-on corroboration specifically confirming API usage (only third-party rclone tool usage in community evidence for sync, not API dev workflow), and no explicit delete/move endpoint citation though files resource implies full CRUD.
